name: ollama-cloud-provider
description: Security-hardened Ollama Cloud language model provider for VS Code Copilot Chat.

commands.title: Ollama Cloud: Set Vision Fallback Model
Ollama Cloud: Set Vision Fallback Connection

ollamaCloud.apiKey.description: Ollama Cloud API key fallback. Prefer the command palette to store it securely in SecretStorage.

ollamaCloud.baseUrl.description: Ollama Cloud OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Must be in allowedBaseUrls or the extension refuses to start.

ollamaCloud.allowedBaseUrls.description: Whitelist of permitted base URLs. The extension refuses to send requests to any baseUrl not in this list.

ollamaCloud.requestTimeoutMs.description: Deprecated — use ollamaCloud.requestMaxDurationMs. Alias for backward compat; mapped to requestMaxDurationMs when requestMaxDurationMs is unset.

ollamaCloud.requestConnectTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Connect timeout in milliseconds — bounds the initial fetch + status check. Retried via maxRetries on timeout. Covers 'server unreachable'. ADR 0005.

ollamaCloud.requestInactivityTimeoutMs.markdownDescription:
⚠️ **Max silence = 120s + this value** (420s at the default). The soft warning fires at 120s and extends the timer to this value — the name reflects the grace ceiling, NOT the total silence budget. See [ADR 0005](docs/adr/0005-streaming-timeout-architecture.md).

**Advanced** — Inactivity timeout in milliseconds — grace period ceiling applied AFTER the soft warning fires. Reset on every stream chunk and :keep-alive SSE comment. Soft warning fires at 120s (logs + extends the timer to this value). Hard kill fires after the full grace period elapses with no new chunks — so total max silence before kill = 120s + this value (420s at the 300s default). Only applies when this value > 120s; at or below 120s the timer fires hard directly (short-timeout path). NO retry (mid-stream retry = double billing). Detects dead connections vs slow reasoning. ADR 0005.

ollamaCloud.requestMaxDurationMs.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Max stream duration in milliseconds — hard ceiling from streamChat entry, never reset. NO retry. Protects token budget from forgotten tabs / crashed callers. ADR 0005.

ollamaCloud.maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries for transient failures (429, 5xx). Uses exponential backoff.

id.description: Stable connection id. Used as the SecretStorage key suffix (ollamaCloud.apiKey.<id>) and the model id prefix.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the model picker origin tag.

type.description: Connection type. Drives the origin label (Cloud/Local/VPS/custom) and the default allowedBaseUrls.

enabled.description: Whether the connection is enabled. Disabled connections are skipped.

openaiCompatiblePath.description: OpenAI-compatible path suffix appended to baseUrl. Defaults to empty (baseUrl already includes /v1).

allowedBaseUrls.description: Per-connection whitelist. The extension refuses to send the connection's API key to any baseUrl not in this list. Defaults to [baseUrl] (fail-closed).

visionModels.description: Per-connection vision wildcard patterns. A model id matching any pattern is treated as image-capable.

requiresApiKey.description: Whether an API key is required for this connection. Defaults to true for cloud/remote/custom, false for local.

enumDescriptions: Disable context filtering for this connection (overrides the global setting).
Structural cleanup only — drop duplicate messages, empty content parts, redundant tool definitions; compact system-prompt whitespace.
safe + context-window truncation, similar-message merging, and metadata stripping.
level.description: Per-connection context-filter override. `auto` (default) inherits the global `ollamaCloud.contextFilter.level`; `off`/`safe`/`aggressive` override it for this connection. See ADR 0007.

ollamaCloud.connections.description: Multi-connection list. Each entry is a distinct OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Cloud, Local, VPS, or custom) with its own allowedBaseUrls whitelist and API key. When empty, the extension uses the legacy single-connection settings.

ollamaCloud.visionModels.description: Global vision wildcard patterns. A model id matching any pattern is treated as image-capable. Per-connection visionModels override this list for that connection's models.

ollamaCloud.visionFallback.enabled.description: Enable Vision Fallback Pass-through (ADR 0004). When the primary model cannot handle an image, route the turn to a vision-capable model. Opt-in, default off. See `ollamaCloud.visionFallback.model` and `ollamaCloud.visionFallback.connection`.

ollamaCloud.visionFallback.model.description: Vision-capable model id used for the fallback turn. When empty, the extension auto-searches the primary connection's catalog for the first vision-capable model. Set via the command palette (Ollama Cloud: Set Vision Fallback Model) or enter a model id manually.

ollamaCloud.visionFallback.connection.description: Optional connection id for the vision fallback. When empty, the extension uses the primary connection (where the primary model lives). Set via the command palette (Ollama Cloud: Set Vision Fallback Connection) when the primary connection has no vision models.

enumDescriptions: Automatically select endpoint with auto-recovery (switches on 3 consecutive 404s, returns after 5 min).

Use the native Ollama /api/chat endpoint (ndjson wire format, object tool arguments, images[] for vision). Phase 1 opt-in — falls back to /chat/completions on HTTP 404 only in auto mode. Use this to bypass the OpenAI-compat translation layer.
Use /v1/responses as primary (structured reasoning, typed events, first-class tool calling). Falls back to /chat/completions on HTTP 404. Recommended — newest and most advanced endpoint.
Use /chat/completions as primary (classic OpenAI-compatible). Falls back to /v1/responses on HTTP 404. Use this if you encounter issues with /v1/responses.
ollamaCloud.preferredEndpoint.description: Primary API endpoint for cloud and remote connections. The other endpoint is used as automatic fallback on HTTP 404. Local Ollama connections always use /chat/completions regardless of this setting. Per-connection `preferredEndpoint` in `ollamaCloud.connections` overrides this global setting.

enumDescriptions: Structural cleanup only — drop duplicate messages, empty content parts, and redundant tool definitions; compact system-prompt whitespace. No message removal, no truncation.
safe + context-window truncation, similar-message merging, and metadata stripping. Can drop context the user wanted — see the per-request log line.
ollamaCloud.contextFilter.level.description: Context filtering level (ADR 0007). `off` (default) sends the payload as-is. `safe` removes duplicate messages, empty content parts, and redundant tool definitions, and compacts system-prompt whitespace. `aggressive` adds context-window truncation, similar-message merging, and metadata stripping. Per-connection `contextFilter.level` in `ollamaCloud.connections` overrides this global setting (`off`/`safe`/`aggressive` override; `auto` inherits).
